data.title: 鸿雪 · 雪停以后的灯
data.description: 雪停后，她回头发现你还在，便轻轻招手请你靠近。远处窗灯亮起时，她没有移开视线。
data.action: 靠窗回眸，指尖轻触窗框
data.camera: 中近景，人物神态与互动清晰
data.promptProse: Standing beside a frosted multi-pane salon window watching silent winter snowflakes fall into the glowing twilight street, Pozyomka looks back over her shoulder, extending a welcoming hand toward the viewer. The room's roaring stone fireplace casts dancing golden and amber reflections across her knit shawl and the frosted glass, creating an inviting sanctuary from the winter chill.
